##### PHP CS Fixer 3.92.0 (bundled exe; PHP 8.4.15) raw dumps #####
##### NOTE: 3.92 has no list-rules subcommand. Rule list generated by enumerating PhpCsFixer\FixerFactory::registerBuiltInFixers() from the phar the launcher extracts to %TEMP%\php-cs-fixer-launcher (script: php.exe dump.php php-cs-fixer.phar).

##### RULES #####
align_multiline_comment [configurable]
    Each line of multi-line DocComments must have an asterisk [PSR-5] and must be aligned with the first one.
    - comment_type (mixed) default="phpdocs_only" allowed: "phpdocs_only" | "phpdocs_like" | "all_multiline"
        Whether to fix PHPDoc comments only (`phpdocs_only`), any multi-line comment whose lines all start with an asterisk (`phpdocs_like`) or any multi-line comment (`all_multiline`).
array_indentation
    Each element of an array must be indented exactly once.
array_push [risky]
    Converts simple usages of `array_push($x, $y);` to `$x[] = $y;`.
array_syntax [configurable]
    PHP arrays should be declared using the configured syntax.
    - syntax (mixed) default="short" allowed: "long" | "short"
        Whether to use the `long` or `short` array syntax.
assign_null_coalescing_to_coalesce_equal
    Use the null coalescing assignment operator `??=` where possible.
attribute_empty_parentheses [configurable]
    PHP attributes declared without arguments must (not) be followed by empty parentheses.
    - use_parentheses (bool) default=false
        Whether attributes should be followed by parentheses or not.
backtick_to_shell_exec
    Converts backtick operators to `shell_exec` calls.
binary_operator_spaces [configurable]
    Binary operators should be surrounded by space as configured.
    - default (mixed) default="single_space" allowed: "align" | "align_by_scope" | "align_single_space" | "align_single_space_minimal" | "align_single_space_by_scope" | "align_single_space_minimal_by_scope" | "single_space" | "no_space" | "at_least_single_space" | null
        Default fix strategy.
    - operators (array<string, ?string>) default=[] allowed: <callback>
        Dictionary of `binary operator` => `fix strategy` values that differ from the default strategy. Supported are: `=`, `*`, `/`, `%`, `<`, `>`, `|`, `^`, `+`, `-`, `&`, `&=`, `&&`, `||`, `.=`, `/=`, `=>`, `==`, `>=`, `===`, `!=`, `<>`, `!==`, `<=`, `and`, `or`, `xor`, `-=`, `%=`, `*=`, `|=`, `+=`, `<<`, `<<=`, `>>`, `>>=`, `^=`, `**`, `**=`, `<=>`, `??` and `??=`.
blank_line_after_namespace
    There MUST be one blank line after the namespace declaration.
blank_line_after_opening_tag
    Ensure there is no code on the same line as the PHP open tag and it is followed by a blank line.
blank_line_before_statement [configurable]
    An empty line feed must precede any configured statement.
    - statements (string[]) default=["break","continue","declare","return","throw","try"] allowed: subset of ["break","case","continue","declare","default","do","exit","for","foreach","goto","if","include","include_once","phpdoc","require","require_once","return","switch","throw","try","while","yield","yield_from"]
        List of statements which must be preceded by an empty line.
blank_line_between_import_groups
    Putting blank lines between `use` statement groups.
blank_lines_before_namespace [configurable]
    Controls blank lines before a namespace declaration.
    - max_line_breaks (int) default=2
        Maximum line breaks that should exist before namespace declaration.
    - min_line_breaks (int) default=2
        Minimum line breaks that should exist before namespace declaration.
braces [deprecated -> single_space_around_construct,control_structure_braces,control_structure_continuation_position,declare_parentheses,no_multiple_statements_per_line,braces_position,statement_indentation,no_extra_blank_lines; configurable]
    The body of each structure MUST be enclosed by braces. Braces should be properly placed. Body of braces should be properly indented.
    - allow_single_line_anonymous_class_with_empty_body (bool) default=false
        Whether single line anonymous class with empty body notation should be allowed.
    - allow_single_line_closure (bool) default=false
        Whether single line lambda notation should be allowed.
    - position_after_anonymous_constructs (mixed) default="same" allowed: "next" | "same"
        Whether the opening brace should be placed on "next" or "same" line after anonymous constructs (anonymous classes and lambda functions).
    - position_after_control_structures (mixed) default="same" allowed: "next" | "same"
        Whether the opening brace should be placed on "next" or "same" line after control structures.
    - position_after_functions_and_oop_constructs (mixed) default="next" allowed: "next" | "same"
        Whether the opening brace should be placed on "next" or "same" line after classy constructs (non-anonymous classes, interfaces, traits, methods and non-lambda functions).
braces_position [configurable]
    Braces must be placed as configured.
    - allow_single_line_anonymous_functions (bool) default=true
        Allow anonymous functions to have opening and closing braces on the same line.
    - allow_single_line_empty_anonymous_classes (bool) default=true
        Allow anonymous classes to have opening and closing braces on the same line.
    - anonymous_classes_opening_brace (mixed) default="same_line" allowed: "next_line_unless_newline_at_signature_end" | "same_line"
        The position of the opening brace of anonymous classes‘ body.
    - anonymous_functions_opening_brace (mixed) default="same_line" allowed: "next_line_unless_newline_at_signature_end" | "same_line"
        The position of the opening brace of anonymous functions‘ body.
    - classes_opening_brace (mixed) default="next_line_unless_newline_at_signature_end" allowed: "next_line_unless_newline_at_signature_end" | "same_line"
        The position of the opening brace of classes‘ body.
    - control_structures_opening_brace (mixed) default="same_line" allowed: "next_line_unless_newline_at_signature_end" | "same_line"
        The position of the opening brace of control structures‘ body.
    - functions_opening_brace (mixed) default="next_line_unless_newline_at_signature_end" allowed: "next_line_unless_newline_at_signature_end" | "same_line"
        The position of the opening brace of functions‘ body.
cast_spaces [configurable]
    A single space or none should be between cast and variable.
    - space (mixed) default="single" allowed: "none" | "single"
        Spacing to apply between cast and variable.
class_attributes_separation [configurable]
    Class, trait and interface elements must be separated with one or none blank line.
    - elements (array<string, string>) default={"const":"one","method":"one","property":"one","trait_import":"none","case":"none"} allowed: <callback>
        Dictionary of `const|method|property|trait_import|case` => `none|one|only_if_meta` values.
class_definition [configurable]
    Whitespace around the keywords of a class, trait, enum or interfaces definition should be one space.
    - inline_constructor_arguments (bool) default=true
        Whether constructor argument list in anonymous classes should be single line.
    - multi_line_extends_each_single_line (bool) default=false
        Whether definitions should be multiline.
    - single_item_single_line (bool) default=false
        Whether definitions should be single line when including a single item.
    - single_line (bool) default=false
        Whether definitions should be single line.
    - space_before_parenthesis (bool) default=false
        Whether there should be a single space after the parenthesis of anonymous class (PSR12) or not.
class_keyword [risky]
    Converts FQCN strings to `*::class` keywords.
class_keyword_remove [deprecated -> ]
    Converts `::class` keywords to FQCN strings.
class_reference_name_casing
    When referencing an internal class it must be written using the correct casing.
clean_namespace
    Namespace must not contain spacing, comments or PHPDoc.
combine_consecutive_issets
    Using `isset($var) &&` multiple times should be done in one call.
combine_consecutive_unsets
    Calling `unset` on multiple items should be done in one call.
combine_nested_dirname [risky]
    Replace multiple nested calls of `dirname` by only one call with second `$level` parameter.
comment_to_phpdoc [risky; configurable]
    Comments with annotation should be docblock when used on structural elements.
    - ignored_tags (string[]) default=[]
        List of ignored tags.
compact_nullable_type_declaration
    Remove extra spaces in a nullable type declaration.
compact_nullable_typehint [deprecated -> compact_nullable_type_declaration]
    Remove extra spaces in a nullable typehint.
concat_space [configurable]
    Concatenation should be spaced according to configuration.
    - spacing (mixed) default="none" allowed: "one" | "none"
        Spacing to apply around concatenation operator.
constant_case [configurable]
    The PHP constants `true`, `false`, and `null` MUST be written using the correct casing.
    - case (mixed) default="lower" allowed: "upper" | "lower"
        Whether to use the `upper` or `lower` case syntax.
control_structure_braces
    The body of each control structure MUST be enclosed within braces.
control_structure_continuation_position [configurable]
    Control structure continuation keyword must be on the configured line.
    - position (mixed) default="same_line" allowed: "next_line" | "same_line"
        The position of the keyword that continues the control structure.
curly_braces_position [deprecated -> braces_position; configurable]
    Curly braces must be placed as configured.
    - allow_single_line_anonymous_functions (bool) default=true
        Allow anonymous functions to have opening and closing braces on the same line.
    - allow_single_line_empty_anonymous_classes (bool) default=true
        Allow anonymous classes to have opening and closing braces on the same line.
    - anonymous_classes_opening_brace (mixed) default="same_line" allowed: "next_line_unless_newline_at_signature_end" | "same_line"
        The position of the opening brace of anonymous classes‘ body.
    - anonymous_functions_opening_brace (mixed) default="same_line" allowed: "next_line_unless_newline_at_signature_end" | "same_line"
        The position of the opening brace of anonymous functions‘ body.
    - classes_opening_brace (mixed) default="next_line_unless_newline_at_signature_end" allowed: "next_line_unless_newline_at_signature_end" | "same_line"
        The position of the opening brace of classes‘ body.
    - control_structures_opening_brace (mixed) default="same_line" allowed: "next_line_unless_newline_at_signature_end" | "same_line"
        The position of the opening brace of control structures‘ body.
    - functions_opening_brace (mixed) default="next_line_unless_newline_at_signature_end" allowed: "next_line_unless_newline_at_signature_end" | "same_line"
        The position of the opening brace of functions‘ body.
date_time_create_from_format_call [risky]
    The first argument of `DateTime::createFromFormat` method must start with `!`.
date_time_immutable [risky]
    Class `DateTimeImmutable` should be used instead of `DateTime`.
declare_equal_normalize [configurable]
    Equal sign in declare statement should be surrounded by spaces or not following configuration.
    - space (mixed) default="none" allowed: "single" | "none"
        Spacing to apply around the equal sign.
declare_parentheses
    There must not be spaces around `declare` statement parentheses.
declare_strict_types [risky; configurable]
    Force strict types declaration in all files.
    - preserve_existing_declaration (bool) default=false
        Whether existing strict_types=? should be preserved and not overridden.
dir_constant [risky]
    Replaces `dirname(__FILE__)` expression with equivalent `__DIR__` constant.
doctrine_annotation_array_assignment [configurable]
    Doctrine annotations must use configured operator for assignment in arrays.
    - ignored_tags (string[]) default=["abstract","access","code","deprec","encode","exception","final","ingroup","inheritdoc","inheritDoc","magic","name","toc","tutorial","private","static","staticvar","staticVar","throw","api","author","category","copyright","deprecated","example","filesource","global","ignore","internal","license","link","method","package","param","property","property-read","property-write","return","see","since","source","subpackage","throws","todo","TODO","usedBy","uses","var","version","after","afterClass","backupGlobals","backupStaticAttributes","before","beforeClass","codeCoverageIgnore","codeCoverageIgnoreStart","codeCoverageIgnoreEnd","covers","coversDefaultClass","coversNothing","dataProvider","depends","expectedException","expectedExceptionCode","expectedExceptionMessage","expectedExceptionMessageRegExp","group","large","medium","preserveGlobalState","requires","runTestsInSeparateProcesses","runInSeparateProcess","small","test","testdox","ticket","uses","SuppressWarnings","noinspection","package_version","enduml","startuml","psalm","phpstan","template","fix","FIXME","fixme","override"]
        List of tags that must not be treated as Doctrine Annotations.
    - operator (mixed) default="=" allowed: "=" | ":"
        The operator to use.
doctrine_annotation_braces [configurable]
    Doctrine annotations without arguments must use the configured syntax.
    - ignored_tags (string[]) default=["abstract","access","code","deprec","encode","exception","final","ingroup","inheritdoc","inheritDoc","magic","name","toc","tutorial","private","static","staticvar","staticVar","throw","api","author","category","copyright","deprecated","example","filesource","global","ignore","internal","license","link","method","package","param","property","property-read","property-write","return","see","since","source","subpackage","throws","todo","TODO","usedBy","uses","var","version","after","afterClass","backupGlobals","backupStaticAttributes","before","beforeClass","codeCoverageIgnore","codeCoverageIgnoreStart","codeCoverageIgnoreEnd","covers","coversDefaultClass","coversNothing","dataProvider","depends","expectedException","expectedExceptionCode","expectedExceptionMessage","expectedExceptionMessageRegExp","group","large","medium","preserveGlobalState","requires","runTestsInSeparateProcesses","runInSeparateProcess","small","test","testdox","ticket","uses","SuppressWarnings","noinspection","package_version","enduml","startuml","psalm","phpstan","template","fix","FIXME","fixme","override"]
        List of tags that must not be treated as Doctrine Annotations.
    - syntax (mixed) default="without_braces" allowed: "with_braces" | "without_braces"
        Whether to add or remove braces.
doctrine_annotation_indentation [configurable]
    Doctrine annotations must be indented with four spaces.
    - ignored_tags (string[]) default=["abstract","access","code","deprec","encode","exception","final","ingroup","inheritdoc","inheritDoc","magic","name","toc","tutorial","private","static","staticvar","staticVar","throw","api","author","category","copyright","deprecated","example","filesource","global","ignore","internal","license","link","method","package","param","property","property-read","property-write","return","see","since","source","subpackage","throws","todo","TODO","usedBy","uses","var","version","after","afterClass","backupGlobals","backupStaticAttributes","before","beforeClass","codeCoverageIgnore","codeCoverageIgnoreStart","codeCoverageIgnoreEnd","covers","coversDefaultClass","coversNothing","dataProvider","depends","expectedException","expectedExceptionCode","expectedExceptionMessage","expectedExceptionMessageRegExp","group","large","medium","preserveGlobalState","requires","runTestsInSeparateProcesses","runInSeparateProcess","small","test","testdox","ticket","uses","SuppressWarnings","noinspection","package_version","enduml","startuml","psalm","phpstan","template","fix","FIXME","fixme","override"]
        List of tags that must not be treated as Doctrine Annotations.
    - indent_mixed_lines (bool) default=false
        Whether to indent lines that have content before closing parenthesis.
doctrine_annotation_spaces [configurable]
    Fixes spaces in Doctrine annotations.
    - after_argument_assignments (null|bool) default=false
        Whether to add, remove or ignore spaces after argument assignment operator.
    - after_array_assignments_colon (null|bool) default=true
        Whether to add, remove or ignore spaces after array assignment `:` operator.
    - after_array_assignments_equals (null|bool) default=true
        Whether to add, remove or ignore spaces after array assignment `=` operator.
    - around_commas (bool) default=true
        Whether to fix spaces around commas.
    - around_parentheses (bool) default=true
        Whether to fix spaces around parentheses.
    - before_argument_assignments (null|bool) default=false
        Whether to add, remove or ignore spaces before argument assignment operator.
    - before_array_assignments_colon (null|bool) default=true
        Whether to add, remove or ignore spaces before array `:` assignment operator.
    - before_array_assignments_equals (null|bool) default=true
        Whether to add, remove or ignore spaces before array `=` assignment operator.
    - ignored_tags (string[]) default=["abstract","access","code","deprec","encode","exception","final","ingroup","inheritdoc","inheritDoc","magic","name","toc","tutorial","private","static","staticvar","staticVar","throw","api","author","category","copyright","deprecated","example","filesource","global","ignore","internal","license","link","method","package","param","property","property-read","property-write","return","see","since","source","subpackage","throws","todo","TODO","usedBy","uses","var","version","after","afterClass","backupGlobals","backupStaticAttributes","before","beforeClass","codeCoverageIgnore","codeCoverageIgnoreStart","codeCoverageIgnoreEnd","covers","coversDefaultClass","coversNothing","dataProvider","depends","expectedException","expectedExceptionCode","expectedExceptionMessage","expectedExceptionMessageRegExp","group","large","medium","preserveGlobalState","requires","runTestsInSeparateProcesses","runInSeparateProcess","small","test","testdox","ticket","uses","SuppressWarnings","noinspection","package_version","enduml","startuml","psalm","phpstan","template","fix","FIXME","fixme","override"]
        List of tags that must not be treated as Doctrine Annotations.
echo_tag_syntax [configurable]
    Replaces short-echo `<?=` with long format `<?php echo`/`<?php print` syntax, or vice-versa.
    - format (mixed) default="long" allowed: "long" | "short"
        The desired language construct.
    - long_function (mixed) default="echo" allowed: "echo" | "print"
        The function to be used to expand the short echo tags.
    - shorten_simple_statements_only (bool) default=true
        Render short-echo tags only in case of simple code.
elseif
    The keyword `elseif` should be used instead of `else if` so that all control keywords look like single words.
empty_loop_body [configurable]
    Empty loop-body must be in configured style.
    - style (string) default="semicolon" allowed: "braces" | "semicolon"
        Style of empty loop-bodies.
empty_loop_condition [configurable]
    Empty loop-condition must be in configured style.
    - style (string) default="while" allowed: "while" | "for"
        Style of empty loop-condition.
encoding
    PHP code MUST use only UTF-8 without BOM (remove BOM).
ereg_to_preg [risky]
    Replace deprecated `ereg` regular expression functions with `preg`.
error_suppression [risky; configurable]
    Error control operator should be added to deprecation notices and/or removed from other cases.
    - mute_deprecation_error (bool) default=true
        Whether to add `@` in deprecation notices.
    - noise_remaining_usages (bool) default=false
        Whether to remove `@` in remaining usages.
    - noise_remaining_usages_exclude (string[]) default=[]
        List of global functions to exclude from removing `@`.
escape_implicit_backslashes [deprecated -> string_implicit_backslashes; configurable]
    Escape implicit backslashes in strings and heredocs to ease the understanding of which are special chars interpreted by PHP and which not.
    - double_quoted (bool) default=true
        Whether to fix double-quoted strings.
    - heredoc_syntax (bool) default=true
        Whether to fix heredoc syntax.
    - single_quoted (bool) default=false
        Whether to fix single-quoted strings.
explicit_indirect_variable
    Add curly braces to indirect variables to make them clear to understand.
explicit_string_variable
    Converts implicit variables into explicit ones in double-quoted strings or heredoc syntax.
final_class [risky]
    All classes must be final, except abstract ones and Doctrine entities.
final_internal_class [risky; configurable]
    Internal classes should be `final`.
    - annotation_exclude (string[]) default=["@final","@Entity","@ORM\\Entity","@ORM\\Mapping\\Entity","@Mapping\\Entity","@Document","@ODM\\Document"] allowed: <callback>
        Class level attribute or annotation tags that must be omitted to fix the class, even if all of the white list ones are used as well (case insensitive).
    - annotation_include (string[]) default=["@internal"] allowed: <callback>
        Class level attribute or annotation tags that must be set in order to fix the class (case insensitive).
    - consider_absent_docblock_as_internal_class (bool) default=false
        Whether classes without any DocBlock should be fixed to final.
    - exclude (string[]) default=["final","Entity","ORM\\Entity","ORM\\Mapping\\Entity","Mapping\\Entity","Document","ODM\\Document"] allowed: <callback>
        Class level attribute or annotation tags that must be omitted to fix the class, even if all of the white list ones are used as well (case insensitive).
    - include (string[]) default=["internal"] allowed: <callback>
        Class level attribute or annotation tags that must be set in order to fix the class (case insensitive).
final_public_method_for_abstract_class [risky]
    All `public` methods of `abstract` classes should be `final`.
fopen_flag_order [risky]
    Order the flags in `fopen` calls, `b` and `t` must be last.
fopen_flags [risky; configurable]
    The flags in `fopen` calls must omit `t`, and `b` must be omitted or included consistently.
    - b_mode (bool) default=true
        The `b` flag must be used (`true`) or omitted (`false`).
full_opening_tag
    PHP code must use the long `<?php` tags or short-echo `<?=` tags and not other tag variations.
fully_qualified_strict_types [configurable]
    Removes the leading part of fully qualified symbol references if a given symbol is imported or belongs to the current namespace.
    - import_symbols (bool) default=false
        Whether FQCNs should be automatically imported.
    - leading_backslash_in_global_namespace (bool) default=false
        Whether FQCN is prefixed with backslash when that FQCN is used in global namespace context.
    - phpdoc_tags (string[]) default=["param","phpstan-param","phpstan-property","phpstan-property-read","phpstan-property-write","phpstan-return","phpstan-var","property","property-read","property-write","psalm-param","psalm-property","psalm-property-read","psalm-property-write","psalm-return","psalm-var","return","see","throws","var"]
        Collection of PHPDoc annotation tags where FQCNs should be processed. As of now only simple tags with `@tag \F\Q\C\N` format are supported (no complex types).
function_declaration [configurable]
    Spaces should be properly placed in a function declaration.
    - closure_fn_spacing (mixed) default="one" allowed: "none" | "one"
        Spacing to use before open parenthesis for short arrow functions.
    - closure_function_spacing (mixed) default="one" allowed: "none" | "one"
        Spacing to use before open parenthesis for closures.
    - trailing_comma_single_line (bool) default=false
        Whether trailing commas are allowed in single line signatures.

        Whether to import, not import or ignore global classes.
    - import_constants (null|bool) default=null
        Whether to import, not import or ignore global constants.
    - import_functions (null|bool) default=null

    - group_types (string[]) default=["classy","functions","constants"] allowed: <callback>

header_comment [configurable]
    Add, replace or remove header comment.
    - comment_type (mixed) default="comment" allowed: "PHPDoc" | "comment"
        Comment syntax type.
    - header (string) REQUIRED
        Proper header content.
    - location (mixed) default="after_declare_strict" allowed: "after_open" | "after_declare_strict"
        The location of the inserted header.
    - separate (mixed) default="both" allowed: "both" | "top" | "bottom" | "none"
        Whether the header should be separated from the file content with a new line.
    - validator (string|null) default=null

    Unify `heredoc` or `nowdoc` closing marker.

        Preferred closing marker.

    - reserved_closing_markers (string[]) default=["CSS","DIFF","HTML","JS","JSON","MD","PHP","PYTHON","RST","TS","SQL","XML","YAML"]
        Reserved closing markers to be kept unchanged.
heredoc_indentation [configurable]
    Heredoc/nowdoc content must be properly indented.
    - indentation (mixed) default="start_plus_one" allowed: "start_plus_one" | "same_as_start"
        Whether the indentation should be the same as in the start token line or one level more.
heredoc_to_nowdoc
    Convert `heredoc` to `nowdoc` where possible.
implode_call [risky]
    Function `implode` must be called with 2 arguments in the documented order.
include
    Include/Require and file path should be divided with a single space. File path should not be placed within parentheses.
increment_style [configurable]
    Pre- or post-increment and decrement operators should be used if possible.
    - style (mixed) default="pre" allowed: "pre" | "post"
        Whether to use pre- or post-increment and decrement operators.
indentation_type
    Code MUST use configured indentation type.
integer_literal_case
    Integer literals must be in correct case.
is_null [risky]
    Replaces `is_null($var)` expression with `null === $var`.
lambda_not_used_import
    Lambda must not import variables it doesn't use.
line_ending
    All PHP files must use same line ending.
linebreak_after_opening_tag
    Ensure there is no code on the same line as the PHP open tag.
list_syntax [configurable]
    List (`array` destructuring) assignment should be declared using the configured syntax.
    - syntax (mixed) default="short" allowed: "long" | "short"
        Whether to use the `long` or `short` syntax for array destructuring.
logical_operators [risky]
    Use `&&` and `||` logical operators instead of `and` and `or`.
long_to_shorthand_operator [risky]
    Shorthand notation for operators should be used if possible.
lowercase_cast
    Cast should be written in lower case.
lowercase_keywords
    PHP keywords MUST be in lower case.
lowercase_static_reference
    Class static references `self`, `static` and `parent` MUST be in lower case.
magic_constant_casing
    Magic constants should be referred to using the correct casing.
magic_method_casing
    Magic method definitions and calls must be using the correct casing.
mb_str_functions [risky]
    Replace non multibyte-safe functions with corresponding mb function.
method_argument_space [configurable]
    In method arguments and method call, there MUST NOT be a space before each comma and there MUST be one space after each comma. Argument lists MAY be split across multiple lines, where each subsequent line is indented once. When doing so, the first item in the list MUST be on the next line, and there MUST be only one argument per line.
    - after_heredoc (bool) default=false
        Whether the whitespace between heredoc end and comma should be removed.
    - attribute_placement (mixed) default="standalone" allowed: "ignore" | "same_line" | "standalone"
        Defines how to handle argument attributes when function definition is multiline.
    - keep_multiple_spaces_after_comma (bool) default=false
        Whether keep multiple spaces after comma.
    - on_multiline (mixed) default="ensure_fully_multiline" allowed: "ignore" | "ensure_single_line" | "ensure_fully_multiline"
        Defines how to handle function arguments lists that contain newlines.

    - elements (string[]) default=["const","method","property"] allowed: subset of ["const","method","property"]
        The structural elements to fix.

phpdoc_no_empty_return
    `@return void` and `@return null` annotations must be removed from PHPDoc.
phpdoc_no_package
    `@package` and `@subpackage` annotations must be removed from PHPDoc.
phpdoc_no_useless_inheritdoc
    Classy that does not inherit must not have `@inheritdoc` tags.
phpdoc_order [configurable]
    Annotations in PHPDoc should be ordered in defined sequence.
    - order (string[]) default=["param","throws","return"] allowed: <callback>
        Sequence in which annotations in PHPDoc should be ordered.
phpdoc_order_by_value [configurable]
    Order PHPDoc tags by value.
    - annotations (string[]) default=["covers"] allowed: subset of ["author","covers","coversNothing","dataProvider","depends","group","internal","method","mixin","property","property-read","property-write","requires","throws","uses"]
        List of annotations to order, e.g. `["covers"]`.
phpdoc_param_order
    Orders all `@param` annotations in DocBlocks according to method signature.
phpdoc_readonly_class_comment_to_keyword [risky]
    Converts readonly comment on classes to the readonly keyword.
phpdoc_return_self_reference [configurable]
    The type of `@return` annotations of methods returning a reference to itself must the configured one.
    - replacements (array<string, string>) default={"this":"$this","@this":"$this","$self":"self","@self":"self","$static":"static","@static":"static"}
        Mapping between replaced return types with new ones.
phpdoc_scalar [configurable]
    Scalar types should always be written in the same form. `int` not `integer`, `bool` not `boolean`, `float` not `real` or `double`.
    - types (mixed) default=["boolean","callback","double","integer","real","str"] allowed: subset of ["boolean","callback","double","integer","never-return","never-returns","no-return","real","str"]
        A list of types to fix.
phpdoc_separation [configurable]
    Annotations in PHPDoc should be grouped together so that annotations of the same type immediately follow each other. Annotations of a different type are separated by a single blank line.
    - groups (string[][]) default=[["author","copyright","license"],["category","package","subpackage"],["property","property-read","property-write"],["deprecated","link","see","since"]] allowed: <callback>
        Sets of annotation types to be grouped together. Use `*` to match any tag character.
    - skip_unlisted_annotations (bool) default=false
        Whether to skip annotations that are not listed in any group.
phpdoc_single_line_var_spacing
    Single line `@var` PHPDoc should have proper spacing.
phpdoc_summary
    PHPDoc summary should end in either a full stop, exclamation mark, or question mark.
phpdoc_tag_casing [configurable]
    Fixes casing of PHPDoc tags.
    - tags (string[]) default=["inheritDoc"]
        List of tags to fix with their expected casing.
phpdoc_tag_no_named_arguments [configurable]
    There must be `@no-named-arguments` tag in PHPDoc of a class/enum/interface/trait.
    - description (string) default=""
        Description of the tag.
    - fix_attribute (bool) default=true
        Whether to fix attribute classes.
    - fix_internal (bool) default=true
        Whether to fix internal elements (marked with `@internal`).
phpdoc_tag_type [configurable]
    Forces PHPDoc tags to be either regular annotations or inline.
    - tags (array<string, 'annotation'|'inline'>) default={"api":"annotation","author":"annotation","copyright":"annotation","deprecated":"annotation","example":"annotation","global":"annotation","inheritDoc":"annotation","internal":"annotation","license":"annotation","method":"annotation","package":"annotation","param":"annotation","property":"annotation","return":"annotation","see":"annotation","since":"annotation","throws":"annotation","todo":"annotation","uses":"annotation","var":"annotation","version":"annotation"} allowed: <callback>
        The list of tags to fix.
phpdoc_to_comment [configurable]
    Docblocks should only be used on structural elements.
    - allow_before_return_statement (bool) default=false
        Whether to allow PHPDoc before return statement.
    - ignored_tags (string[]) default=[]
        List of ignored tags (matched case insensitively).
phpdoc_to_param_type [risky; configurable]
    Takes `@param` annotations of non-mixed types and adjusts accordingly the function signature.
    - scalar_types (bool) default=true
        Fix also scalar types; may have unexpected behaviour due to PHP bad type coercion system.
    - types_map (array<string, string>) default=[]
        Map of custom types, e.g. template types from PHPStan.
    - union_types (bool) default=true
        Fix also union types; turned on by default on PHP >= 8.0.0.
phpdoc_to_property_type [risky; configurable]
    Takes `@var` annotation of non-mixed types and adjusts accordingly the property signature..
    - scalar_types (bool) default=true
        Fix also scalar types; may have unexpected behaviour due to PHP bad type coercion system.
    - types_map (array<string, string>) default=[]
        Map of custom types, e.g. template types from PHPStan.
    - union_types (bool) default=true
        Fix also union types; turned on by default on PHP >= 8.0.0.
phpdoc_to_return_type [risky; configurable]
    Takes `@return` annotation of non-mixed types and adjusts accordingly the function signature.
    - scalar_types (bool) default=true
        Fix also scalar types; may have unexpected behaviour due to PHP bad type coercion system.
    - types_map (array<string, string>) default=[]
        Map of custom types, e.g. template types from PHPStan.
    - union_types (bool) default=true
        Fix also union types; turned on by default on PHP >= 8.0.0.
phpdoc_trim
    PHPDoc should start and end with content, excluding the very first and last line of the docblocks.
phpdoc_trim_consecutive_blank_line_separation
    Removes extra blank lines after summary and after description in PHPDoc.
phpdoc_types [configurable]
    The correct case must be used for standard PHP types in PHPDoc.
    - groups (string[]) default=["alias","meta","simple"] allowed: subset of ["alias","meta","simple"]
        Type groups to fix.
phpdoc_types_order [configurable]
    Sorts PHPDoc types.
    - case_sensitive (bool) default=false
        Whether the sorting should be case sensitive.
    - null_adjustment (mixed) default="always_first" allowed: "always_first" | "always_last" | "none"
        Forces the position of `null` (overrides `sort_algorithm`).
    - sort_algorithm (mixed) default="alpha" allowed: "alpha" | "none"
        The sorting algorithm to apply.
phpdoc_var_annotation_correct_order
    `@var` and `@type` annotations must have type and name in the correct order.
phpdoc_var_without_name
    `@var` and `@type` annotations of classy properties should not contain the name.
pow_to_exponentiation [risky]
    Converts `pow` to the `**` operator.
protected_to_private
    Converts `protected` variables and methods to `private` where possible.
psr_autoloading [risky; configurable]
    Classes must be in a path that matches their namespace, be at least one namespace deep and the class name should match the file name.
    - dir (null|string) default=null
        If provided, the directory where the project code is placed.
random_api_migration [risky; configurable]
    Replaces `rand`, `srand`, `getrandmax` functions calls with their `mt_*` analogs or `random_int`.
    - replacements (array<string, string>) default={"getrandmax":"mt_getrandmax","rand":"mt_rand","srand":"mt_srand"} allowed: <callback>
        Mapping between replaced functions with the new ones.
regular_callable_call [risky]
    Callables must be called without using `call_user_func*` when possible.
return_assignment
    Local, dynamic and directly referenced variables should not be assigned and directly returned by a function or method.
return_to_yield_from
    If the function explicitly returns an array, and has the return type `iterable`, then `yield from` must be used instead of `return`.
return_type_declaration [configurable]
    Adjust spacing around colon in return type declarations and backed enum types.
    - space_before (mixed) default="none" allowed: "one" | "none"
        Spacing to apply before colon.
self_accessor [risky]
    Inside class or interface element `self` should be preferred to the class name itself.
self_static_accessor
    Inside an enum or `final`/anonymous class, `self` should be preferred over `static`.
semicolon_after_instruction
    Instructions must be terminated with a semicolon.
set_type_to_cast [risky]
    Cast shall be used, not `settype`.
short_scalar_cast
    Cast `(boolean)` and `(integer)` should be written as `(bool)` and `(int)`, `(double)` and `(real)` as `(float)`, `(binary)` as `(string)`.
simple_to_complex_string_variable
    Converts explicit variables in double-quoted strings and heredoc syntax from simple to complex format (`${` to `{$`).
simplified_if_return
    Simplify `if` control structures that return the boolean result of their condition.
simplified_null_return
    A return statement wishing to return `void` should not return `null`.
single_blank_line_at_eof
    A PHP file without end tag must always end with a single empty line feed.
single_blank_line_before_namespace [deprecated -> blank_lines_before_namespace]
    There should be exactly one blank line before a namespace declaration.
single_class_element_per_statement [configurable]
    There MUST NOT be more than one property or constant declared per statement.
    - elements (string[]) default=["const","property"] allowed: subset of ["const","property"]
        List of strings which element should be modified.
single_import_per_statement [configurable]
    There MUST be one use keyword per declaration.
    - group_to_single_imports (bool) default=true
        Whether to change group imports into single imports.
single_line_after_imports
    Each namespace use MUST go on its own line and there MUST be one blank line after the use statements block.
single_line_comment_spacing
    Single-line comments must have proper spacing.
single_line_comment_style [configurable]
    Single-line comments and multi-line comments with only one line of actual content should use the `//` syntax.
    - comment_types (string[]) default=["asterisk","hash"] allowed: subset of ["asterisk","hash"]
        List of comment types to fix.
single_line_empty_body
    Empty body of class, interface, trait, enum or function must be abbreviated as `{}` and placed on the same line as the previous symbol, separated by a single space.
single_line_throw
    Throwing exception must be done in single line.
single_quote [configurable]

        Whether to fix double-quoted strings that contains single-quotes.

        List of constructs which must be followed by a single space.

    Each trait `use` must be done as single statement.

    Replace all `<>` with `!=`.

    - stick_comment_to_next_continuous_control_statement (bool) default=false
        Last comment of code block counts as comment for next block.
static_lambda [risky]
    Lambdas not (indirectly) referencing `$this` must be declared `static`.
static_private_method [risky]
    Converts private methods to `static` where possible.
strict_comparison [risky]
    Comparisons should be strict.
strict_param [risky]
    Functions should be used with `$strict` param set to `true`.
string_implicit_backslashes [configurable]
    Handles implicit backslashes in strings and heredocs. Depending on the chosen strategy, it can escape implicit backslashes to ease the understanding of which are special chars interpreted by PHP and which not (`escape`), or it can remove these additional backslashes if you find them superfluous (`unescape`). You can also leave them as-is using `ignore` strategy.
    - double_quoted (mixed) default="escape" allowed: "escape" | "unescape" | "ignore"
        Whether to escape backslashes in double-quoted strings.
    - heredoc (mixed) default="escape" allowed: "escape" | "unescape" | "ignore"
        Whether to escape backslashes in heredoc syntax.
    - single_quoted (mixed) default="unescape" allowed: "escape" | "unescape" | "ignore"
        Whether to escape backslashes in single-quoted strings.
string_length_to_empty [risky]
    String tests for empty must be done against `''`, not with `strlen`.
string_line_ending [risky]
    All multi-line strings must use correct line ending.
stringable_for_to_string
    A class that implements the `__toString()` method must explicitly implement the `Stringable` interface.
switch_case_semicolon_to_colon
    A case should be followed by a colon and not a semicolon.
switch_case_space
    Removes extra spaces between colon and case value.
switch_continue_to_break
    Switch case must not be ended with `continue` but with `break`.
ternary_operator_spaces
    Standardize spaces around ternary operator.
ternary_to_elvis_operator [risky]
    Use the Elvis operator `?:` where possible.
ternary_to_null_coalescing
    Use `null` coalescing operator `??` where possible.
trailing_comma_in_multiline [configurable]
    Arguments lists, array destructuring lists, arrays that are multi-line, `match`-lines and parameters lists must have a trailing comma.
    - after_heredoc (bool) default=false
        Whether a trailing comma should also be placed after heredoc end.
    - elements (string[]) default=["arrays"] allowed: subset of ["arguments","array_destructuring","arrays","match","parameters"]
        Where to fix multiline trailing comma (PHP >= 8.0 for `parameters` and `match`).
trim_array_spaces
    Arrays should be formatted like function/method arguments, without leading or trailing single line space.
type_declaration_spaces [configurable]
    Ensure single space between a variable and its type declaration in function arguments and properties.
    - elements (string[]) default=["function","property"] allowed: subset of ["constant","function","property"]
        Structural elements where the spacing after the type declaration should be fixed.
types_spaces [configurable]
    A single space or none should be around union type and intersection type operators.
    - space (mixed) default="none" allowed: "none" | "single"
        Spacing to apply around union type and intersection type operators.
    - space_multiple_catch (mixed) default=null allowed: "none" | "single" | null
        Spacing to apply around type operator when catching exceptions of multiple types, use `null` to follow the value configured for `space`.
unary_operator_spaces [configurable]
    Unary operators should be placed adjacent to their operands.
    - only_dec_inc (bool) default=false
        Limit to increment and decrement operators.
use_arrow_functions [risky]
    Anonymous functions with return as the only statement must use arrow functions.
visibility_required [deprecated -> modifier_keywords; configurable]
    Classes, constants, properties, and methods MUST have visibility declared, and keyword modifiers MUST be in the following order: inheritance modifier (`abstract` or `final`), visibility modifier (`public`, `protected`, or `private`), set-visibility modifier (`public(set)`, `protected(set)`, or `private(set)`), scope modifier (`static`), mutation modifier (`readonly`), type declaration, name.
    - elements (string[]) default=["const","method","property"] allowed: subset of ["const","method","property"]
        The structural elements to fix.
void_return [risky]
    Add `void` return type to functions with missing or empty return statements, but priority is given to `@return` annotations.
whitespace_after_comma_in_array [configurable]
    In array declaration, there MUST be a whitespace after each comma.
    - ensure_single_space (bool) default=false
        If there are only horizontal whitespaces after the comma then ensure it is a single space.
yield_from_array_to_yields [risky]
    Yield from array must be unpacked to series of yields.
yoda_style [configurable]
    Write conditions in Yoda style (`true`), non-Yoda style (`['equal' => false, 'identical' => false, 'less_and_greater' => false]`) or ignore those conditions (`null`) based on configuration.
    - always_move_variable (bool) default=false
        Whether variables should always be on non assignable side when applying Yoda style.
    - equal (bool|null) default=true
        Style for equal (`==`, `!=`) statements.
    - identical (bool|null) default=true
        Style for identical (`===`, `!==`) statements.
    - less_and_greater (bool|null) default=null
        Style for less and greater than (`<`, `<=`, `>`, `>=`) statements.

97) @auto

98) @auto:risky
